purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, viewer configuration, bounded anonymous request outcomes, safe-field handling, and coverage limits.
assessment: Punjab Land Records Authority and Pakpattan district administration establish official provincial/local land-record custody. The official PULSE viewer exposes Punjab cadastral maps and a Pakpattan layer. An exact-point anonymous query returned one safe ID-plus-complete-polygon response.
registryAssessment: Local/provincial registry custody found through official PLRA, Pakpattan district administration revenue duties, and the PULSE cadastral viewer. This establishes a real registry/map route, not citywide geometry completeness.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Punjab Land Records Authority portal describes Punjab digital land-record services and Arazi Record Centres.
Official Pakpattan district administration page assigns maintenance/updating of revenue and land records to district revenue administration.
Official PULSE viewer states its digital map is based on Mussavie maps, is indicative rather than a legal boundary, and exposes a Parcels/cadastral-map interface.
Official ArcGIS layer metadata names the layer Pakpattan, polygon geometry, OBJECTID as the OID field, and native spatial reference WKID 102100/latest 3857.

viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: Verified from layer metadata: esriGeometryPolygon; native WKID 102100/latest WKID 3857. Native fields were inspected but only OBJECTID was requested in the retained query.

attempts.result: HTTP 200 HTML retrieved. Current JavaScript/configuration exposed the Punjab cadastral service, Pakpattan layer id 26, and public token route.
HTTP 200 JSON returned a short-lived public service token. Token value was used transiently for the bounded request and not retained in packet artifacts.
HTTP 200 layer metadata; layer name Pakpattan, polygon geometry, OBJECTID OID field, native WKID 102100/latest 3857, service capabilities Map/Query/Data.
HTTP 200 GeoJSON; exact WUP point intersect query returned one Polygon with OBJECTID 13944240. Requested outFields=OBJECTID only, returnGeometry=true, outSR=4326, resultRecordCount=3.

geometryDecision: Retain one full polygon because the official service returned a safe stable native OBJECTID and complete polygon geometry. No source-specific attributes beyond the canonical identity were retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Punjab PULSE publishes a Punjab cadastral-map service with a Pakpattan layer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Layer metadata and one exact-point anonymous ID-plus-polygon response verified.

remainingUncertainty: The single exact-point hit does not establish citywide completeness. PULSE itself calls the map indicative and not a legal boundary. Update cadence, all-source coverage outside the returned neighborhood, and adapter/runtime behavior remain unverified.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Serial reviewer must independently qualify the real adapter and broader coverage; this packet alone does not enable runtime.
